verdict.rationale: PostHog documents linking session replays directly to flag rollouts and to exceptions/errors ('see the session replays, events, and exceptions from the people who got the flag'), and session replay's synced DevTools panel shows errors at the moment they happened, supporting a PM-style jump from error/event to replay. However, the evidence never explicitly documents jumping from a funnel drop-off step to session replays, only from feature-flag cohorts/exceptions. missing for 10: explicit funnel-to-replay linking documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
